**Issue #3535 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3535: Patch: Stinkyscape+ F, the foundation
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape+ set (#3596, tracker #3533). **The foundation**: everything the other parts share, so that each of them touches only its own files.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md) (all of it); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9` until this part brings them onto this fullsend's branch. Where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md). `{For AI: …}` notes in the designer's text are the designer's notes to you, the builder, not to the game's AI (SP5).

## Scope

1. **The plan and the list on this branch.** Bring `docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md` and `JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md` from the planning branch (`git fetch origin claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9 && git checkout FETCH_HEAD -- docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md`). Fill in SP7's table of the seven AI cards, and SP8's table with the parts' issue numbers (they are this issue's siblings under #3596). Then bring SP8 up to date with the owner's second change of 2026-11-10: the night bot builds every part of fullsend 1, F and E1–E9 included, as parts of #3596 (which replaced #3534) on its integration branch, so the paragraph that says F and E1–E9 are built in a Claude session and land on `main` first is no longer true; the shipped-card moves to S01 and `UNIQUE_RANDOM_DRAWS = false` stay as they are. SP8's "Opened on" line gains #3596.
2. **The set held.** Append `StinkyscapePlus = "Stinkyscape+" { stage: Held, segment: "stinkyscapeplus", abbreviation: Some("S+"), shadow_ban_share: Some((1, 5)) }` to `set_table!` (`crates/engine/src/wire/catalog_types.rs`, R3114000, R1420). Add the scripts module `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/`, registered by `register_all()`, and whatever else a new set touches (Training Grounds' foundation, #2193's parts, is the latest model). Deck and trio codes number it per R1410.
3. **The vocabulary.** Declare the new keyword kinds (Evolve, Burn, Toxic, GIGA, Flexible, Frenzy, Evasive, Tipsy), with no behavior: the engine parts build each. Declare the new tags (Mindustrial, Mineral, Automa-α, -β, -γ, -δ, -Ω and -ζ, Paperclip, Wincon, and any other the list uses that the catalog lacks). Add the server's migration admitting the new tags (`crates/server`, with `tests/store/contract.rs` and the SQL suites as a migration needs).
4. **Every catalog entry.** Write all 186 entries of the list, plus the Warhero Token (`stinkyscapeplus-t-warhero-token`), the ten Terminus Starships (`stinkyscapeplus-t-terminus-starship-<slug>`, ten names of your choosing) and the seven AI cards. Each entry gets both faces, cost, type, printed rarity, tags, stats, keywords, params and text. Ids, numbering and fixes follow SP1 and SP5: the second card on each reused number moves to #161 to #166, and the four `#Token` cards are unnumbered tokens. Text follows the house wording (`card-text.yaml`, `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md`). Run `cargo jackioh names` and `catalog check`.
5. **A stub script per card**: its file, its `pub const ID`, its header comment quoting the designer's text, and a `pub fn script()` that does nothing yet. The card parts fill them in, so no part needs to touch the module list.
6. **The spec.** Add the set's §8 section with one row per entry (the engine notes say "built in S<nn>" until each part lands), §1's list of sets, and BUILD.md's M14 milestone (no must-pass table: rule 6).
7. **The seven AI cards** designed in SP7 (2 Fruit, 2 Jlockeed, 2 CN, 1 KY), under ST15's constraints.

## Readings

- The set stays `Held`, so no pool, deck, list, patch or golden trace sees it (R1420). Nothing here needs a fragment.
- An entry's keywords that an engine part will build are declared now, so that `catalog check` passes and no card part needs to touch another's entry.
- Every number goes in `params` (rule 9). No script logic goes here.

## Done when

- [ ] All entries above are in `crates/cards/catalog.json`, and `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `names --check` and `spec check` pass.
- [ ] Every card has its stub script and is registered. `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts` passes with the set held, and `cargo jackioh golden check` and `fuzz --seeds 200` are unchanged.
- [ ] The §8 rows, BUILD M14 and SP7's AI cards are written. The plan and the designer's list are on this branch.

Part of #3596.
```
